author: GamerMetSwag
body: I got banned 2 years ago for fly-hacking and yes i was hacking that time but that was 2 years ago and i've learned my lesson that i will never hack again but now i always play nebula on my other account but i'm just curious if i can get a unban after 2 years?

replies.author: Protel
replies.body:
Thank you for taking the time to appeal, however ban evasion (playing on another account while you're banned) is not allowed on this server.

This appeal is denied until further notice. 

-John
